what: the crate is `#![no_std]` even under test, unlike the other no_std crates (`#![cfg_attr(not(test), no_std)]`), so each test module needs `extern crate std;` and explicit `std::` imports, and hegel macros that expand to `::std` paths may not resolve
cost: test code written with Hegel::new instead of #[hegel::test] to avoid the macro paths; unverified until compiled
cause: lib.rs was written as a contract file before its tests
